text: A tennis player wins a game without losing a single point. How many points did they win?
In a standard Rubik's Cube, how many of the small cubes show three coloured faces?
why: Only the corner pieces show three colours, and a cube has 8 corners.

text: What's the fewest straight cuts that will divide a round cake into 8 equal pieces?
why: Two cuts across make 4 quarters; one cut through the middle, sideways, makes 8.

text: In a standard 52-card pack, how many red cards show a jack, queen or king?
why: Two red suits, each with a jack, queen and king.

text: How many of the twelve months have the letter R in their name?
why: January, February, March, April, September, October, November, December.
